method: Rechecked DeepSeek Vision/Token Usage and Claude Vision official documentation; ran eight offline unittest assertions against lesson scope, category-based cost wording, Markdown paragraph breaks, the complete Python fence, synthetic crop geometry, input validation and line width. No provider requests were made.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 resolution and compression summaries have no archived per-call raw responses, complete usage semantics, exact model snapshot, repeated runs, or independently reproducible scorer. They were not reproduced and do not establish a quality/cost curve.
The fake image object validates only local crop geometry and parameter checks. It does not test real Pillow behavior, provider image processing, visual quality, usage, billing, or latency.
DeepSeek and Claude claims are scoped to the cited documentation checked on 2026-10-22; no other provider, compatibility endpoint, or deployed model behavior is verified.
